name: Monsieur Rafael Devereux
appearance: An elegant continental gentleman, olive-skinned with dark wavy hair and expressive eyes, in a beautifully tailored plum-and-silver French-cut coat with lace at the cuffs and a knowing half-smile.
definition: A French aristocrat in exile — a comte without his lands, living on a rescued fortune and impeccable charm. Cosmopolitan, cultured and dangerously fluent in flattery; no one is quite sure how much of him is true, nor whether his wealth is as large as it dazzles.
voice: Silken, cultivated and theatrical, flattery delivered like poetry; charming, unreadable, always a step ahead of the conversation.
discoveries: His title may outshine his purse.
Fluent in three languages of flattery.
